A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same CDFlow study. Their text, equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A–D support reliable comparison. The omitted NeurIPS checklist in v4 is an identifiable deletion, not an extraction gap.

before.justification: v1 reports original CDFlow density-estimation results, runtime measurements, ablations, and Flow Matching experiments in Section 4 and Appendices A–C.

after.justification: v4 retains these original empirical results, including the image experiments, runtime analyses, and toy-dataset Flow Matching evaluations.

M1.justification: The circulant–diagonal parameterization, FFT-based operations, CDFlow architecture, training components, and CDMLP adaptation are unchanged. The revised captions only clarify model attribution.

E1.justification: Both retain CIFAR-10, ImageNet, Galaxy, and Chessboard/Moons/Circles evaluations. Table 2's inconsistent CIFAR-100 column heading versus its Galaxy caption and accompanying discussion also remains unchanged; it does not establish added coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in Tables 2–3 and Figures 4–6, including the image-model baselines, runtime methods, constrained linear-layer variants, and MLP/EMLP/WMLP/BFMLP comparisons.

E3.justification: The same model configurations, preprocessing, evaluation metrics, hardware settings, and runtime testing procedures are reported. Appendix C retains its five-layer MLP experiments; no experimental setting is revised or added.

E4.justification: Figure 2's factor-count ablation, Appendix A's linear-layer constraint analysis, Appendix B's reshaping-overhead analysis, and the appendix visualizations are retained with the same evidence.

E5.justification: Deleting checklist item 7 removes the explicit statement that error bars are not reported. Table 2 nevertheless already contains identical ± entries in both versions, and Figure 4 still reports averages over 100 runs. No statistical procedure or additional uncertainty estimation is introduced.

E6.justification: All numerical results and plotted findings are retained. Examples include CDFlow's CIFAR-10 BPD of 3.31 ± 0.004 in Table 2 and CDMLP's Chessboard NLL of 7.0425 in Table 3. Figures 7–11 contain the same visual results despite caption edits.

T1.justification: The factorization, determinant and inverse derivations in Equations 9–19, together with the complexity analysis in Table 1, are unchanged. No substantive mathematical assumption, definition, or proof is added or removed.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims concerning efficient invertible layers, image density estimation, and periodic data. The claimed inverse and log-determinant speedups remain 1.17× and 4.31×.

C2.justification: The restriction to 1×1 convolutions in Section 3.3, reduced runtime advantage at larger spatial sizes in Section 4.4, and expressiveness–efficiency interpretation in Appendix A are retained. Checklist removal does not remove these substantive limitations.

D1.justification: The deleted checklist contained plans to release code and data upon publication and provide code/model documentation and usage instructions. v4 omits these commitments. Implementation and hardware details remain unchanged; the deletion does not establish any actual change in resource availability.

R1.justification: The research references and positioning relative to previous structured-matrix methods and normalizing flows are unchanged. Removing administrative checklist links does not change the scientific related work.

P1.justification: v4 removes the standalone NeurIPS checklist and makes short caption additions. The research narrative, section sequence, and Appendices A–D remain intact, so this is a limited structural and wording edit.

P2.justification: Figures 7–8 now explicitly identify CDMLP, and Figures 9–11 identify CDFlow as the generating model. There is minor appendix reflow, but the figures, tables, axes, legends, and underlying visual content are retained.

improvement.justification: v4 preserves the scientific argument, empirical evidence, and implementation details. Figures 7–11 gain clearer attribution, while checklist removal reduces administrative material but also drops future-release commitments and an error-bar reporting statement. These limited gains and disclosure losses do not materially change the paper's evidential support or practical reproducibility.
